title: Boston Gas Company d/b/a KeySpan Energy Delivery New England submits for review and approval a 275-Day Firm Transportation Service Agreement with the Massachusetts Port Authority.
petitioner: Boston Gas Company d/b/a National Grid
filings: The Department approves theproposed Agreement. The Department also finds that the pricing terms of the Agreement are competitively sensitive, and therefore Grants the Company's request for protection from public disclosure. Commissioners participating were: James Connelly, Chairman; Commissioners W. Robert Keating, Paul B. Vasington, Eugene J. Sullivan, Jr., and Deidre K. Manning. (GC 02-03)
